resources.string: Languages other than English need their language pack DLC in Download/Diablo3Mobile/aoc/<index>; without it the game stays in English.
The game picks its own render resolution for each Switch mode; the display hardware scales the picture to the screen.
In the shape of the screen, no stretching (next launch)

\"In the shape of the screen\" renders the game in the screen\'s own proportions (e.g. 2000×900 docked, 1600×720 handheld on a 20:9 phone): on a wider screen you see more of the world at the sides, on a narrower one (16:10, 4:3, foldables) a little less, the HUD at the screen edges. Screens narrower than 4:3 get 4:3 with thin bars at the top and bottom. It needs a restart of the game; until then the picture keeps 16:9 with bars.
Widescreen: stretch loading screens to the whole screen
30 saves battery and heat. The game itself runs at 60 (as on the Switch); higher limits are not offered.
In use now: system driver (%1$s did not start)
Driver packages (adrenotools: meta.json + .so, or a .zip) go to Download/Diablo3Mobile/drivers/.
Delete %1$s? Its package in Download/Diablo3Mobile/drivers/ is deleted too.
Each controller is a player (the first one is player 1)
Touch screen is player 1, controllers are players 2–4
Players 2–4 join the way they do on a docked Switch: press a button on their controller in the game. Docked mode only (handheld mode has one player, as on the Switch).
The game\'s \"Local wireless\" play works between phones on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot. Nothing is opened until you start or search for a local game.
Logs go to Download/Diablo3Mobile/logs (boot.log, logcat.txt, several MB each). Off: none are written there; a crash report (crash.txt) is still written if the game crashes.
Faded: the ⚙ button is drawn at the opacity below until it is pressed; it stays in the same place.
The last launches with %1$s ended before the first frame: the system driver is used.
Driver %1$s did not start (%2$s): the system driver is used.

Touch: the left stick appears under your thumb in the lower left; touch and hold the world to walk there, double-tap to evade toward the point; skills on the right (A primary, B, X, Y, R, ZR), L = potion. The MENU button switches to menu gestures: swipe to move the selection, tap = A, long press = hold A, B stays a button.
About once a second the skill icons are copied from the HUD of the game (bottom left) onto the buttons with the same letter; a button whose letter the HUD does not show keeps its plain look.
Saves this dialog, then drag the controls on the screen; Reset layout puts them back. Positions are kept for each layout separately.
Touch layout: walking to the finger
Hero height on the picture (from the top): %1$d%%
The hero walks from his spot on the screen toward the held finger. Depth correction makes up for the slanted camera: lower values turn touches above or below the hero more toward straight up or down.
Drag a control to move it
Sticks appear only under the finger (as D2R Mobile)
The last Diablo III run ended unexpectedly. Report: %1$s
Vulkan driver %1$s cannot run here: %2$s. The system driver is used.
it is for Adreno 6xx+ (Snapdragon) GPUs only
it is for Mali GPUs only
it is for Samsung Xclipse GPUs only
it is for PowerVR GPUs only
this is a Linux glibc build (for Winlator-style glibc containers); use the Android package of this driver (e.g. …-adrenotools.zip)
the driver did not load and the system driver ran instead (details in the log)
the driver sees no GPU on this phone
the driver could not be opened
the package has no driver library

Lets you create seasonal heroes (Create Seasonal Hero in the main menu) and play them offline with the season journey. A seasonal hero belongs to its season number: switch the season off or to another number and the game treats that hero as from an ended season.
Ring of Royal Grandeur for free (Season 16)
Instant crafting, enchanting, identifying and Kanai\'s Cube
Kanai\'s Cube does not use up materials
More greater rift progress orbs from elites
Equip more than one copy of a legendary
If the game build does not match, a mod switches itself off (red line in the log) and the game runs as usual.

Everything here is off by default and applies on next launch. Partly ported from d3hack by god-jester (Switch mod, GPL-2.0). Back up your saves before trying: seasonal heroes and cheated items stay in them.
Each season\'s theme is a separate switch in the game, so several can be on together. They apply to every hero, seasonal or not.
Anniversary event (d3hack: holiday gifts and the like)
Easter-egg world (d3hack: the cow level flag)
God mode (invulnerable, immune, items never break, walk through monsters, unlimited resource)
d3hack debug flags: every hit a critical / overkill / crushing blow, ancient rolls always succeed and roll primal, item debug info in tooltips
